text:
zane: late-night poll: building a tiny desk from the I-watched-a-5-minute-tutorial-but-still-winging-it school of carpentry. need a 45-55min playlist that's upbeat enough to stop me dozing but mellow enough not to make me hammer things twice as hard. bonus points for a 30s triumphant jingle for when the final bolt goes in. :raised_hands:

claire: love this. my vibe: start with ambient electro, slip into some steady funk, finish with one classic anthem. keeps momentum without turning it into a rave.

jules: vote for mixing in a spoken-word 5-min bit around 25 mins so you actually read the instructions. otherwise i just skip a step and regret it.

zane: yes to the spoken-word checkpoint. also someone suggested a tiny trumpet fanfare for the final bolt. perfect.

claire: quick seed list: 1) Tycho - 'Awake' (for focused, steady opener) 2) Khruangbin - 'Time (You and I)' (mid groove) 3) Sly & The Family Stone - short funk cut 4) a 30s trumpet/jingle at the end (could be a snippet of 'Also sprach Zarathustra' or a custom clip)

jules: also add one lo-fi hiphop track between 15-25 to avoid decision fatigue.

spotify-bot: Generated suggestion: "Night Build Radio (45-50m)"  12 tracks  https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3exampleNightBuildLink

zane: gorgeous. can someone drop a 30s jingle file? i can set it as an alarm.

claire: i made one years ago for moving boxes: low brass + snare rimshot, heroic but tiny. i can upload it.

jules: oath, attach it and i'll rate on a 1-5 'Makes Me Feel Like a Carpenter' scale.

claire: uploading now to the thread (also dropping in #random-uploads).

(10 minutes later)

zane: playlist queued, jingle downloaded, instructions read for real this time. starting. wish me luck. :sunglasses:

(50 minutes later)

zane: update: desk assembled, one leftover dowel (nature keeps a mystery), jingle used at 49:12  cinematic. uploaded pic to #random-photos. thanks team. :sparkles:

jules: photo or it didn't happen. looks great! score 4/5 on 'Makes Me Feel Like a Carpenter' (would be 5 if there were celebratory confetti). :confetti_ball:

claire: confetti next time. also note: do not try to simultaneously hold two planks and answer the phone. learned that the hard way. :grimacing:
